svg.title: Separate publication commits each output Dataset individually
svg.desc: A conceptual plan has two valid separate outputs. Output A is committed successfully. If a later publication of output B fails, A remains available and B must be reported as failed. This diagram illustrates transaction boundaries rather than an observed application failure.
svg.text: Publication status belongs to each output Dataset
Conceptual failure boundary · no actual Dataset or observed incident is shown
A valid plan selects separate outputs for accepted calibrations
Names and selected mappings are checked before publication begins.
Its Dataset and metadata become available.
Keep the actual ID and inspect this result.
B must not be reported as completed.
Result: A remains committed; investigate and recover B deliberately.
The whole selected set is not one all-or-nothing multi-Dataset transaction.
